import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long M = 1000000007L;
    static int d;
    static Node[] hp, md;

    static class Node {
        long[][] dp, cnt;
        boolean[] mark, tark;

        Node() {
            dp = new long[d + 1][d + 1];
            cnt = new long[d + 1][d + 1];
            mark = new boolean[d];
            tark = new boolean[d];
        }

        Node(Node other) {
            dp = new long[d + 1][d + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(other.dp[i], 0, dp[i], 0, d + 1);
            }
            cnt = new long[d + 1][d + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(other.cnt[i], 0, cnt[i], 0, d + 1);
            }
            mark = other.mark.clone();
            tark = other.tark.clone();
        }

        Node clone() {
            return new Node(this);
        }

        void mrg(Node nd) {
            // reset cnt to 0
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(cnt[i], 0);
            }
            // matrix multiplication (mod M)
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d; k++) {
                        long a = (dp[k][j] % M + M) % M;
                        long b = (nd.dp[i][k] % M + M) % M;
                        sum = (sum + (a * b) % M) % M;
                    }
                    cnt[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            // handle mark merging
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                if (mark[i] && !nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = dp[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!mark[i] && nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[j][i] = nd.dp[j][i];
                    }
                }
                mark[i] |= nd.mark[i];
            }
            // copy cnt back to dp
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(cnt[i], 0, dp[i], 0, d + 1);
            }
        }

        void shift(int x) {
            // reset cnt to 0
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(cnt[i], 0);
            }
            // rotate dp by x mod d
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) {
                    cnt[(i + x) % d][(j + x) % d] = dp[i][j];
                }
                cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = dp[i][d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = dp[d][i];
            }
            cnt[d][d] = dp[d][d];
            // copy cnt back to dp
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(cnt[i], 0, dp[i], 0, d + 1);
            }
            // rotate marks
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                tark[i] = mark[(i + x) % d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                mark[i] = tark[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node get(long x) {
        long h = x;
        long pw = 1;
        int t = -1;
        while (h >= d) {
            h /= d;
            pw *= d;
            t++;
        }
        x %= pw;
        if (t == -1) {
            return hp[(int) h].clone();
        }
        Node ans = md[t].clone();
        Node ht = md[t].clone();
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            ht.shift(1);
            ans.mrg(ht);
        }
        ht = get(x);
        ht.shift((int) h);
        ans.mrg(ht);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n--;

        ArrayList<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp > 0) {
            v.add((int) (tmp % d));
            tmp /= d;
        }

        // initialize static arrays with size enough for d and log depth
        hp = new Node[d + 5];
        md = new Node[65]; // lg = 64, +1 for safety

        // hp[0]
        hp[0] = new Node();
        hp[0].dp[d][d] = 2;
        hp[0].dp[d][0] = -1;
        hp[0].dp[0][d] = 1;
        hp[0].mark[0] = true;

        md[0] = hp[0].clone();

        for (int i = 1; i < d; i++) {
            hp[i] = new Node();
            hp[i].dp[d][d] = 2;
            hp[i].dp[d][i] = -1;
            hp[i].dp[i][d] = 1;
            hp[i].mark[i] = true;
            md[0].mrg(hp[i]);
            hp[i] = md[0].clone();
        }

        int sz = v.size();
        for (int i = 1; i <= sz; i++) {
            md[i] = md[i - 1].clone();
            Node ht = md[i - 1].clone();
            for (int j = 1; j < d; j++) {
                ht.shift(1);
                md[i].mrg(ht);
            }
        }

        Node ans = get(n);
        long out = ans.dp[d][d];
        out = (out % M + M) % M;
        System.out.println(out);
    }
}
